Wrote `HANDOFF.md`.

Core content:
- **Root cause:** `gateway.pool.perRequest: false -> true` (config generation 119) kill connection reuse. Pool size 20 saturate, `in_use` pinned 20/20, wait queue 13 -> 271. `timeout.upstreamMs 2000 -> 2500` compound it.
- **Window:** 02:14:18.972Z start, still erroring at log end 03:59:27Z. 530 503s, ~1h45m, flat 50 per 10 min. Node-3 of 3 only — real impact likely 3x.
- **Roll back:** `dep-4471`, gateway, a.novak, 02:12-02:14.

Doc also carry: all 5 other deploys ruled out with reason, why not upstream/DB fault (`/health` stayed 200), and worker drift flagged as separate ticket — **do not** roll back `dep-4470` as part of this mitigation.
